Delays are in steps and exist only for detected spells (optimistic alone; read with the detection rate). `pre-declared` = fraction of spells where P(target) was already >= threshold the step BEFORE the switch.

Controlled test (calm, then forced stress on steps 20-39, then calm; 10 seeds): onset detected in 100% (median delay 0 steps), recovery declared in 100% (median delay 0 steps), false alarm before the window in 0% of episodes.
